(Incorporation)
The Registrar–
(i) He shall note all the records;
(ii) He shall organize and record meetings;
(iii) He  shall  maintain  a  proper  coordination
among the Board of Management;
(iv) He  shall  record  the  documents  of  new
proposals and projects and issue necessary
guidelines to carry out them.
(d) Assistance Registrars (03 posts)–
(i) They shall perform duties assigned by the
Registrar;
(ii) They shall actively assits in every activity
of the Registrar.
(i) He  shall  be  responsible  for  organizing  all
the special projects precisely and efficiently
carried out by the Organization.
(i) He shall administer all the finance;
(ii) He  shall  maintain  all  the  transactions
methodically,  econiomically,  efficiently,
precisely and transparently;
(iii) He shall be responsible for maintaining and
updating records thereof;
